headline: Healthcare Software Implementation and Training | Workflow Configuration | MBBS-Trained Physician
summary: MBBS-trained physician with four years at Greenway Health, a US EHR software company, owning end-to-end implementations for close to 200 client practices. I run discovery with each customer, map how they work today into a clean configuration, set them up, and train the people who use it (200+ trained, from providers to medical assistants). I write the training material and SOPs, bring customer feedback back to product, and I'm comfortable with PHI and privacy requirements. Before software I worked in emergency medicine and the ICU, so I know the clinical side of the workflows I configure.
greenway_bullets: Owned end-to-end implementations for close to 200 client practices, from discovery and workflow documentation through configuration, go-live support and adoption.
Ran discovery with each practice to document pain points and goals, then configured practice-specific workflows and settings.
Trained 200+ end users, including providers, nurse practitioners, nurses and medical assistants; wrote role-based training material and SOPs.
Brought recurring customer problems to product as PRDs and feature requests; many shipped to clients.
Took part in UAT and SIT, and triaged defects from detection through stage-gate release as a member of the Patient Safety and Functional Advisory Committees.
Clinical lead for a new AI-first EHR from Aug 2025: defined user personas, mapped end-to-end workflows and built React prototypes before engineering handoff.
Presented to clients and at the Greenway Engage provider conference.
skills: customer discovery, workflow mapping, platform configuration, data setup, go-live support, project hygiene across CRM and project tools
role-based curricula, live training, SOPs, runbooks, help articles, stakeholder communication
API and webhook integrations, defect triage, PHI and privacy awareness, clinical workflows in emergency, ICU and ambulatory care
thesis_html: Customers go live smoothly when onboarding is built by someone who has worked the floor.
why_fit: Trained 200+ users and wrote the guides and SOPs behind it.
Turned recurring client pain points into PRDs; many shipped.
